# Appendix {#sec-appendix}

## Downloads {#sec-downloads}

```{r}
#| label: downloads
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
zip_bundle <- function(files, zip_name) {
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)
  out <- file.path(tempdir(), zip_name)
  unlink(out)
  utils::zip(out, files, flags = "-j9Xq")
  out
}
tab_zip <- zip_bundle(table_files, "carolina_highground_tables.zip")
ml_zip  <- zip_bundle(file.path(paths$ml_dir, c("nc_flood_event_model_table.parquet", "nc_storm_event_model_table.parquet",
                                                "feature_dictionary.csv", "target_definitions.csv", "target_config.json",
                                                "split_recommendation.csv", "run_manifest.json")), "carolina_highground_ml_ready.zip")
cat(sprintf("* **Figures**: each figure has its own download link; high-resolution copies of all %d figures are saved in `%s`.\n", length(figure_files), p$figures_dir))
cat(sprintf("\n* **All tables** (%d CSV files, also saved in `%s`)\n", length(table_files), p$tables_dir))
if (!is.null(tab_zip)) cat(download_link(tab_zip, "carolina_highground_tables.zip"))
cat(sprintf("\n* **Machine-learning files** (Parquet tables + documentation, also in `%s`)\n", p$ml_dir))
if (!is.null(ml_zip)) cat(download_link(ml_zip, "carolina_highground_ml_ready.zip"))
```

## Limitations

* **Hydrology from a 62 m DEM.** Drainage area and HAND come from the project's DEM, which stops at the state line (basins starting outside NC are undercounted and flagged) and blurs narrow valleys.
* **Coordinates.** `r comma(sum(is.na(model_table$longitude)))` events (mostly forecast-zone records) have no usable NOAA coordinates. Their spatial features are missing; no centroids are substituted.
* **Timing.** Imperviousness is year-matched through 2023 (later events use 2023). NCDOT and NHD are current snapshots, not conditions in the year of each event.
* **Damage** figures are NOAA estimates in nominal dollars. Blank damage fields are treated as 0 and flagged.
* **Soils** are summarized from tabular SSURGO only. **Rainfall** is daily (gridMET, 4 km), so short intense bursts are smoothed out. **Tract SVI** percentiles are ranks within each release.
* **Partial year** `r paste(p$partial_years, collapse = ", ")` is incomplete.

## Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config-summary
#| echo: false
tibble::tribble(
  ~setting, ~value,
  "years", sprintf("%s-%s (partial: %s)", p$start_year, p$end_year, paste(p$partial_years, collapse = ", ")),
  "study area", sprintf("%s: %s", p$study_area, paste(p$study_counties, collapse = ", ")),
  "CRS (analysis / geographic)", sprintf("EPSG:%s / EPSG:%s", p$analysis_crs, p$geographic_crs),
  "buffers (event / stream / infrastructure)", sprintf("%s / %s / %s m", p$event_buffer_m, p$stream_buffer_m, p$infrastructure_buffer_m),
  "feature event scope", p$feature_event_scope,
  "NHD flowline FTypes", paste(p$nhd_flowline_ftypes, collapse = ", "),
  "target", sprintf("deaths >= %s OR damage > q%s of %s damage (basis: %s)", p$death_target_value, p$damage_quantile,
                    if (p$target_positive_damage_only) "positive" else "all", p$target_threshold_basis),
  "split", sprintf("train <= %s, validation <= %s, test after", p$train_end_year, p$validation_end_year),
  "download_data / use_cached_features / refresh_derived_data", paste(p$download_data, p$use_cached_features, p$refresh_derived_data, sep = " / ")
) |> knitr::kable(col.names = c("Setting", "Value"))
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Figure download links: save the image shown in the same code cell.
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  const link = e.target.closest("a.fw-fig-download");
  if (!link) return;
  // Look in the link's own cell first, then in earlier cells (e.g. a Python
  // figure whose link is emitted by the R cell right after it).
  let cell = link.closest(".cell") || link.parentElement;
  let img = cell ? cell.querySelector(".cell-output-display img, img") : null;
  let prev = cell;
  while (!img && prev && (prev = prev.previousElementSibling)) {
    const imgs = prev.querySelectorAll("img");
    if (imgs.length) img = imgs[imgs.length - 1];
  }
  if (!img) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = img.src;
  a.download = link.dataset.filename || "figure.png";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
});
</script>
```
